detail.longDescription: The screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished. What's new in 4.0: - Glass Loupe, a zoom that magnifies one detail - Split screen, also for vertical video - Edit your video like you edit text - Camera cutout: you, without your background - Hide sensitive data and faces automatically - Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more
